text:
emma.p: Heads up — FinBank's procurement hit a failure on GCP marketplace PO ingestion. They uploaded a DocuSign-signed bundle as a .zip; portal returned a 422 attachment hash mismatch. :grimacing:
rachel.s: They insist on DocuSign ZIPs, finance/legal won't accept single PDFs. Any quick workaround?
tony.ops: paste the exact portal error?
emma.p: here: `400 Bad Request {\"error\":\"attachment_hash_mismatch\",\"detail\":\"expected 9f2b..., got 27a1...\"}`
lucy.eng: That usually means checksum changed during unzip/normalization. We had a similar issue last year with nested envelopes + signing metadata.
maya.ops: marketplace-bot shows libunzip bump on 2026-02-18 (commit c3f2b1) — moved streaming->in-memory; note: altered filename/normalization behavior.
marketplace-bot: @channel deploy 2026-02-18 libunzip upgrade (c3f2b1) — relaxed filename normalization, may affect signed binary payloads.
anil.legal: If original signed bytes are modified we risk compliance exposure for customers requiring preserved artifact integrity. We should offer an opt-in that preserves raw bytes and captures consent/audit.
rachel.s: FinBank wants a fix in 24h or they pause the purchase. Sales is flagged.
tony.ops: Short-term ask: can procurement upload raw signed PDFs (multiple attachments) instead of DocuSign zip? Portal supports multi-file PO attachments.
emma.p: They push back — their workflow mandates DocuSign zip. Can we implement a passthrough that preserves raw archived bytes? Estimate?
lucy.eng: Rough: 1 eng, 2 days to add a "preserve_blob" flag that bypasses normalization and streams bytes to storage. Need security review for streaming large blobs and zip-bomb checks.
maya.ops: Ops risks: memory/disk spikes; must enforce quotas and unzip depth limits. Also add zip-bomb scanner.
anil.legal: I'll draft minimal consent: "By opting into raw-blob ingestion the customer acknowledges Redwood will ingest and store original signed artifacts without normalization for PO acceptance; customer remains responsible for signature verification."
tony.ops: We can toggle a canary route for FinBank today routing to preserve_blob once legal + product signoff.
marketplace-bot: created ticket MP-5829 "preserve-zip-bytes-canary" assigned to @lucy.eng.
emma.p: Great. Rachel — secure customer ACK ASAP and paste here. Eng/ops on standby. :thumbsup:
rachel.s: On call now, pushing for ACK. Will update thread in 30m. :phone:
